messages:
ziya: Flagging a small but consistent error uptick on atlas-search canary at 7% eu-north. Recommend freezing percent increase.

deploy-bot: deploybot: Canary rollout started: atlas-search v4.0.1 -> 7% eu-north at 3740000000. Health: degraded, errors 0.7% (baseline 0.06%), p99 +170ms.

ops-rami: Can someone post quick graf?

ziya: https://monitoring.redwood/internal/d/atlas-canary  p95 200ms, p99 610ms, errors concentrated on tokenizer shard 9 timeout path.

nora: Timeout path on shard 9 rings like a KV-prefetch regression. Holding makes sense. Propose routing pin eu-north to stable v3.9.7 and drain canary.

ev an: (typo) evan: +1 to pin. Also suggest adding a short temporary rate limit on prefetch to reduce pressure while infra triages.

ops-rami: Command I'll run to pin and drain: ```
redwood routing override --svc atlas-search --region eu-north --target v3.9.7 --drain-canary --reason "hold: shard9 timeout spike"
```

pm-lucy: Quick question: does pinning require a change-window or release-note retraction? We already announced 4.0.1.

nora: Pinning is a routing override; no change-window necessary. We should append an entry to release notes: "eu-north rollout paused and pinned to v3.9.7 pending RCA." PMs can push that line.

ziya: Rollback/runbook thresholds I propose: sustained errors >=1.5% for 5m OR p99 >850ms for 10m -> immediate full rollback (set global stable to v3.9.7 and cancel other region canaries).

ops-rami: Creating ROUTE ticket and executing now.

(15s)

ops-rami: Done. eu-north pinned to v3.9.7, canary drained. Verified traffic on stable nodes; p99 trended back to baseline in ~38s. :white_check_mark:

evan: I'll add prefetch throttling to the canary config in infra so the issue doesn't cascade if someone accidentally bumps percent.

pm-lucy: I'll update release notes and add a short customer-facing line. Also flag docs about the hotfix process if we need a patch release.

nora: Assigning to infra/serving and infra-kv for shard-9 investigation. Adding jemalloc and network traces to the ticket.

ziya: For now HOLD on percent increases or region promotions until infra confirms the root cause or we get an explicit rollback decision. Reopen thread if we need to cutover or rollback.
